sources.snippet: LunuNeth AI is an integrated, mobile-first AI diagnostic framework specifically built for Sri Lankan onion farmers. The system provides real-time, microclimate-aware diagnostic capabilities to detect and manage diseases, pests, and nutrient deficiencies.
